summary.en: Manage boards, items, and column values

description.zh: 读取和更新看板、分组、条目与列值，支持按条件检索。适合把任务进度同步进对话，或批量调整条目状态。首次连接在浏览器登录 monday.com 授权。
description.en: Read and update boards, groups, items, and column values, with filtered lookups. Useful for bringing task status into a conversation or updating items in bulk. Sign in to monday.com in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 monday.com 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to monday.com and authorize on first connect
